title: Plan Timetable Record
description: A past or future milestone in producing a plan, aligned with the planning.data.gov.uk plan-timetable dataset: https://digital-land.github.io/specification/dataset/plan-timetable/
$comment: Reviewed against the planning.data.gov.uk plan-timetable specification on 2026-10-16.

reference.description: A reference for the timetable entry that is unique within the dataset and permanent.

name.description: The name of the timetable entry.

plan.description: The reference of the plan this event relates to.

plan-event.description: The type of event or milestone.

event-date.description: The date the authority intends to meet the plan event.

predicted-date.description: The predicted date of the plan event.

actual-date.description: The date the plan event actually happened.

document-url.description: The URL of a document related to the event.

documentation-url.description: The web page where documentation for the event can be found.

notes.description: Notes on how the data was made or how it can be interpreted.

organisation.description: The organisation responsible for the record.

entry-date.description: The date this information was entered as a record.

start-date.description: The date the validity of the record starts.

end-date.description: The date the validity of the record ends.

date.description: A date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

curie.description: A compact identifier made of a prefix, a colon and a reference, such as local-authority:BUC.
